stem.text: The graphs show possible current-voltage ($I$-$V$) characteristics for a filament lamp and for a semiconductor diode.

stem.label: P
stem.alt: Current-voltage graph with vertical axis I and horizontal axis V, origin 0, labelled P above. A curve starts at the origin and rises with decreasing slope.

stem.label: Q
stem.alt: Current-voltage graph with vertical axis I and horizontal axis V, origin 0, labelled Q above. A curve starts at the origin and rises with increasing slope.

stem.label: R
stem.alt: Current-voltage graph with vertical axis I and horizontal axis V, origin 0, labelled R above. A horizontal segment lies along the voltage axis from the origin, then a steep straight line rises.

stem.label: S
stem.alt: Current-voltage graph with vertical axis I and horizontal axis V, origin 0, labelled S above. A straight line starts above the origin on the current axis and rises gently to the right.
